art.incomplete: The copy came out incomplete; try again.
art.noSpace: Not enough free space: {needed} MB needed, {free} MB free.
art.none: There is no card art export yet. In the game: Settings > Mod > Export card art, then come back.
confirm.gone: Android's confirmation is no longer available. Press the button again to start over.
done.text:
Start Warpforge from your home screen.

- If it asks for "All files access", allow it: the loader keeps its files there.
- The first start after patching sits on a black screen for up to a minute while the loader sets itself up. Later starts are quicker.
- The mod updates itself from then on.
done.title: All done
err.backupIncomplete: The backup is missing the game's main file or its arm64 code file. Found: {files}
err.backupNoApk: That file holds no .apk files. Pick the game's .apks or .xapk backup.
err.gameVersion: This is game version {version}; the loader and the mod are made for {wanted}.
err.loaderChecksum: The downloaded loader package does not match its checksum; nothing was changed. Try again later.
err.loaderDownload: Could not download the loader package from GitHub ({code}). Check the connection and try again.
err.network: Could not reach the server ({error}). Check the connection and try again. Nothing on the device was changed by this step.
err.noArm64: The game's arm64 code file is missing. This device's copy of the game may not be the arm64 version.
err.noDataPack: The game's data pack (UnityDataAssetPack, about 700 MB) is missing; the patched game would not start. Start the original game once so Android downloads it, then try again.
err.noDataPackBackup: The game's data pack (UnityDataAssetPack, about 700 MB) is missing; the patched game would not start. Make the backup again with all its parts.
err.noSpace: Not enough free space: about {needed} GB is needed while patching, {free} GB is free. It is given back afterwards.
err.notInstalled: The patched game was not installed. {why} The patched files are kept; press the button again to retry.
err.patchFailed: Patching did not finish. The log below says where it stopped.
err.patchFewFiles: Patching left fewer files than expected: {files}
err.stoppedKept: Stopped. Nothing was changed; the patched files are kept until the next patch.
err.unexpected:
Something went wrong: {error}

The log at the bottom has the details; "Share logs" sends it.
fix.off: The black screen fix is off; the loading video plays again. Close the game fully and start it again.
fix.on: The black screen fix is on. Close the game fully and start it again.
install.conflict: Android refused it because a copy of the game with a different signature is still installed.
install.incompatible: Android says the game does not fit this device ({details}).
install.storage: There is not enough free space on the device.
key.notKey: That is not a signing key saved by this app.
key.saved: Key saved. Keep that file private. If this app is ever reinstalled, "Load a saved signing key" puts it back, so the game can be patched again without removing it.
lang.title: Language
mod.badChecksum: The downloaded mod does not match the server's checksum; nothing was changed.
mod.foreignUrl: The server's mod address is not on the server itself; refused.
mod.noneOnServer: The server has no Android mod to hand out right now.
mod.older: The server's mod ({server}) is older than the one on this device ({device}); nothing was changed.
mod.reason.unknownKey: the download is signed with a key this app does not know
mod.refused: The mod from the server was refused: {reason}. Only mod builds signed by the Warpforge Revival project are installed; nothing was changed.
mod.updated: Mod {version} is in place. Close the game fully and start it again.
remove.textOriginal:
The game on this device is the original from the store. Android only accepts the copy patched here after that one is removed, so the app removes it after patching. Android asks you to confirm.

Your account, decks and progress are on the server and are not affected. The game's downloaded files come back from the server. The MelonLoader folder stays.
remove.textPatched:
The game on this device was patched with a different key (on a PC). Android only accepts the copy patched here after that one is removed, so the app removes it after patching. Android asks you to confirm.

Your account, decks and progress are on the server and are not affected. The game's downloaded files come back from the server. The MelonLoader folder stays.
remove.title: Remove the game first?
srv.bad: Write a server address, without spaces or quotes.
srv.text: For example example.com (port 8780 is assumed). Write https://... or http://... to choose the connection. Close the game fully first; the change applies the next time it starts.
srv.title: Server address
status.art: Card art export: made in the game on {date} ({size} MB).
status.artNone: Card art export: none yet. In the game: Settings > Mod > Export card art.
status.modMissing: Mod: not on the device yet.
status.modThere: Mod: on the device ({date}); the game keeps it up to date.
status.noGame: Game: not installed. Install it from the Play Store first, or patch from a backup file.
status.otherPatch: Patched elsewhere (PC): patching here removes it first (the app asks).
status.ourPatch: Patched by this app: a new patch installs over it.
status.requiredUpdate: A required update of this app ({version}) is available. Update the app first (button above); patching is paused until then.
status.wrongVersion: Warning: the mod is made for game version {version}.
still.incomplete: The loading video in the game file looks incomplete.
still.noFrame: Could not take the loading video's last frame.
still.noLength: Could not read the loading video's length.
still.noVideo: The game file has no loading video (sharedassets0.resource).
still.notFound: No loading video found in the game file.
tools.artAbout: Make the export in the game first: Settings > Mod > Export card art.
tools.artSave: Save card art export to Downloads
tools.artSaveNone: Save card art export to Downloads (no export yet)
tools.fixAbout: Shows a still picture instead of the loading video, for devices that end up on a black menu after loading. Works on the already patched game; nothing is patched again.
tools.fixNeedsFiles: Apply the black screen fix (needs access to the loader's folder)
tools.fixNeedsGame: Apply the black screen fix (needs the patched game)
tools.keyAbout: The key this app signs the patched game with. Keep a copy: patching again with another key means removing the game first.
tools.keySave: Save a copy of the signing key
tools.serverAbout: The Warpforge Revival server the mod connects to (ServerUrl in the mod's settings). Close the game fully before changing it.
tools.serverNeedsFiles: Needs access to the loader's folder (Patcher page).
ui.allowFiles: Allow access to the loader's folder
ui.allowInstall: Allow this app to install the game
ui.intro: Puts the mod loader and the Warpforge Revival mod into your own copy of the game, on this device. Nothing from the game is downloaded or shared.
ui.patchNeedsGame: Patch and install (needs the installed game)
ui.stillBox: Fix black menu after loading (shows a still picture instead of the loading video)
upd.checkFailed: Could not check for updates ({error}). Check the connection and try again.
upd.needsInstall: This app needs "Allow this app to install the game" to update itself too. Press that button first.
upd.notInstalled: The app update was not installed. {why}
upd.requiredText:
Warpforge Patcher {version} is available (you have {have}).

This update is required: patching is paused until the app is updated.

Updating keeps your saved signing key. Android asks you to confirm, then the app restarts as the new version.
upd.text:
Warpforge Patcher {version} is available (you have {have}).

Updating keeps your saved signing key. Android asks you to confirm, then the app restarts as the new version.
upd.title: Update available
update.badChecksum: The downloaded update does not match the checksum in its release notes; nothing was installed.
update.noChecksum: That release has no checksum for its APK, so the app will not install it. Download it from the releases page instead.
update.notNewer: The downloaded update is not newer than this app; nothing was installed.
update.otherApp: The downloaded update is a different app; nothing was installed.
update.otherKey: The downloaded update is not signed with this app's key; nothing was installed.
update.unreadable: The downloaded update is not a readable app package.
